annotations.title: Dutch rent points check: legal maximum rent and allowed increase

description: For a rented independent home (zelfstandige woning: own front door, kitchen and toilet) in the Netherlands: from its points under the points system (woningwaarderingsstelsel, WWS), the rental sector (social up to 143 points, regulated mid-rent up to 186, free sector above), the legal maximum basic monthly rent (kale huur) for 2026, whether a current rent is above it, and the maximum yearly rent increase for that sector. The points come from the government's Huurprijscheck on huurcommissie.nl. Rooms (onzelfstandige woonruimte) use a different table and are not covered.

contract_start.description: Start date of the rental contract, YYYY-MM-DD (optional; mid-rent limits apply to contracts from 1 July 2024)

current_rent.description: Current basic monthly rent (kale huur, without service costs) in euros (optional)

points.description: Points of the home under the points system (from the Huurprijscheck)

proposed_increase_pct.description: A rent increase the landlord proposed, in % (optional)
